transcript: Speaker A: Okay, bye. See you. Pooja, tu abhi bhi yahin hai? Kya karti hai aajkal? [Pooja, are you still here? What do you do these days?] Speaker B: Main bas ghar... you know... [I just... home... you know...] Speaker B (VO): Neha airport pe kaam karti hai. Duniya bhar ke logon se English mein baat karti hai. Aur main? School mein usse zyada marks the mere. Shaadi, bacche, ghar... is sab mein topper Pooja kahin kho gayi. Us raat mujhe English Seekho mila. ’1 trial. Maine socha, mere se ab hoga ya nahi? Phir socha, ’1 mein kya jaata hai? Hindi mein samjhane wale chhote videos, basic se. Aur AI coach 24 ghante chat pe practice karne ke liye. Subah kaam se pehle 15 minute, raat ko practice. Galat bolo toh sudhaar deti hai. 100 baar bhi galat bolo, woh kabhi judge nahi karti. Kabhi yeh nahi bolti 'itna bhi nahi aata'. Akele, safe, apni speed se. [Neha works at the airport and speaks English. I was a school topper but got lost in household chores. I found English Seekho's ’1 trial. It has short Hindi videos and a 24/7 AI chat coach. It corrects mistakes without judgment, letting me learn safely at my own pace.] Speaker B (Interview): Good morning. I have three years of experience managing my household, and I'm a quick learner. I'd love this opportunity. Speaker B (VO): Front desk job, ’16,000 mahina. Aur pichle hafte Neha ko maine call kiya, English mein. [Front desk job, ’16,000 a month. And last week I called Neha in English.] Speaker C: Bas ’1 se shuru karo. English Seekho ka trial lo aur bas roz 15 minute practice karo. [Start with just ’1. Take the English Seekho trial and practice 15 minutes daily.] Speaker D: English Seekho app download karo. [Download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: Ok bye see you, पूजा [Pooja], तू अभी भी यही है [Are you still here], क्या करती है आजकल [What do you do these days], मैं बस घर you know [I just home you know], airport पे काम करती है [works at the airport], English थी मेरे [I had more marks than her in school], शादी बच्चे घर [मैरेज किड्स होम], अपनी speed ऱ१ trial, सुबह काम ऱ१८००० महीना [’16000 a month], बस ऱ१ से शुरू करो [Start with just ’1], English Seekho का trial लो [Take the English Seekho trial], ऑर बस ऱ१५ मिनट practice करो [and practice 15 minutes daily], English Seekho : Speaking App.
summary: A housewife feels left behind after meeting her successful, English-speaking former classmate. She uses the English Seekho app's 1-rupee trial to practice English with an AI coach, eventually landing a front desk job. The ad encourages viewers to download the app and practice for 15 minutes daily.
